name: email_term_end_cancellation_draft_reply
use_case: Pick up a billing request that arrived by email
branch: Karen's term-end cancellation is already scheduled (CX-1101, effective 2026-11-01); the desk reads thread th_b03_cancel_term_end and the renewal terms that show it, and drafts the confirmation with the exact end date
tests: Drafts a reply on Karen's thread confirming the scheduled cancellation and its end date as the renewal terms show them; a draft claiming a cancellation that is not scheduled is refused
instruction:
You are Kendra Price, a billing operations coordinator at Cloudnest (User ID: U_OPS1). You are reviewing the incoming billing queue.

Please ask the billing desk assistant to check email thread th_b03_cancel_term_end sent by Karen Kite (KiteWorks, T11), check their renewal terms, and prepare an email draft in reply confirming that their cancellation will be effective at the end of their current term on 2026-11-01 and that they will retain full access until then. Karen confirmed the cancellation with the billing desk in chat on 14 October, so it should already be scheduled; if the desk finds it is not, you want the draft to say the request is pending rather than done.

Your details:
- Customer Name: Karen Kite
- Customer Email: karen@kiteworks.com
- Tenant ID: T11 (KiteWorks)
- Your User ID: U_OPS1
- Thread ID: th_b03_cancel_term_end
- Latest Message ID: bmsg_026

persona.name: Kendra Price
persona.initial_message: Please check email thread th_b03_cancel_term_end from Karen Kite requesting term-end cancellation, check KiteWorks renewal terms, and draft a reply confirming access continues until term end.

arguments.body: Hi Karen, KiteWorks' cancellation is scheduled: your subscription ends at the end of the current term on 2026-11-01 and will not renew. You keep full access to the Basic plan and its features until then. The open add-on invoice inv_11_addon is separate and still due.
